info.title: Total.Recall MCP Server
info.description: An MCP server that gives AI coding agents persistent memory — and measures their behaviour. Ships 34 Model Context Protocol tools over stdio for .NET test-coverage uplift, plus a behaviour observatory (tool-call telemetry, cycle detection, deterministic eval grading) and a reflection-based scanner (assembly, Cobertura coverage, test inventory). Install as a global .NET tool: `dotnet tool install -g TotalRecall.Mcp` then point `.vscode/mcp.json` at `total-recall`.
